Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Represents a single booking appointment made by a customer.

customerName.description: The full name of the customer.

customerEmail.description: The email address of the customer.

customerPhone.description: The phone number of the customer.

serviceName.description: The name of the service booked.

totalPrice.description: The total price for the service and any add-ons.

addons.description: A list of any selected add-ons.

receiptDataUri.description: A data URI of the uploaded payment receipt image.

status.description: The current status of the booking.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the booking was created.

definition.description: Stores all booking appointments. This collection is accessed by both customers (for creation) and the admin (for management).
